title: TC-RB-001: Refresh renders primary with a visible "Refresh" label and the options trigger mirrors primary
verifies: the default view-mode Refresh button is primary, shows the visible 'Refresh' label, its options trigger mirrors primary, and the default tooltip reads 'Refresh'

title: TC-RB-002: Refresh demotes to outline in layout edit mode while Save is primary, then restores primary on exit
verifies: entering layout edit demotes Refresh to outline and keeps Save primary, and exiting restores Refresh to primary

title: TC-RB-003: a pending refresh turns both the Refresh button and its options trigger warning, then primary after Refresh
verifies: an un-applied variable change turns both the Refresh button and its options trigger warning, and clicking Refresh clears both back to primary

title: TC-RB-004: Auto Run keeps Refresh primary and labelled
verifies: with Auto Run on the Refresh button stays primary and labelled and the options trigger stays primary
